trust_decision.summary: A Calcite model is trusted executable configuration: every class name in a model field (custom schema/table factory, UDF className, JDBC driver, dialect factory, lattice statistic provider) is loaded and instantiated by reflection with no restriction; the published fix decides which names are rejected in ModelHandler via a new package-private ClassNameFilter denylist, and nowhere else.

landing_point.why: Reading only 'externally-controlled input selects classes in Calcite', an engineer lands on the model reader in org.apache.calcite.model; visit(JsonCustomSchema) is the first place where a model field (`factory`) is handed to AvaticaUtils.instantiatePlugin, and every other class-name sink in the file looks the same.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names model class-name fields; `operand` is documented as factory-specific attributes (JsonCustomSchema.java:46-50) and the factory class itself (JdbcSchema$Factory) is on the fix's allow path, so its operand strings read as the adapter's business rather than model validation.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Third-party and in-repo SchemaFactory/TableFactory/UDF classes outside the denylist, including the 'ClassName#STATIC_FIELD' form, must keep loading; an allowlist of org.apache.calcite.* in the model package, or a blanket reflection ban, breaks these legitimate models (the fix's own test asserts JdbcSchema$Factory and a #INSTANCE reference are allowed).

O6_input_shapes: plain fully-qualified class name in any of the model fields factory / className / jdbcDriver / sqlDialectFactory / statisticProvider

the 'ClassName#STATIC_FIELD' plugin form accepted by Avatica, documented for the model at core/src/main/java/org/apache/calcite/model/JsonLattice.java:91-92 (field stripped before matching, fix.diff:187-190)
denylist pattern semantics: exact class name, or package prefix when the pattern ends in '.' (fix.diff:192-197)
denylist extension via -Dcalcite.model.classes.denied, appended to the built-in entries (fix.diff:28-29, fix.diff:124-127)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Model `type: custom` with factory org.apache.calcite.adapter.jdbc.JdbcSchema$Factory (allowed by the fix) and operands dataSource / sqlDialectFactory / jdbcDriver, which reach AvaticaUtils.instantiatePlugin and the driver class unchecked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: operands are factory-specific attributes the advisory never names, and the factory class itself is legitimately allowed, so it reads as adapter configuration, not model validation
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one package away (org.apache.calcite.adapter.jdbc), reached from the same model file

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Lattice.Builder.statisticProvider(String) public builder method instantiates the named LatticeStatisticProvider.Factory in build() with no class filter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a Java caller who can name a class in builder code can already run code, so this reads as a programmatic API and not as externally controlled model input
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package (org.apache.calcite.materialize); the model route to the same sink is checked in ModelHandler

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `schemaFactory` connection property is a PLUGIN-typed property resolved to a SchemaFactory instance before any model exists, and Driver then re-embeds the already-loaded class name in a synthetic inline model
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the property is a connect-string setting supplied by the embedding application and is documented as 'Ignored if MODEL is specified' (core/src/main/java/org/apache/calcite/config/CalciteConnectionProperty.java:125)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package (org.apache.calcite.jdbc / org.apache.calcite.config); the load happens before ModelHandler runs

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CREATE FOREIGN SCHEMA ... LIBRARY '<class>' SQL DDL instantiates an arbitrary SchemaFactory (with OPTIONS values passed as its operand map) with no class filter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the advisory and fix are about Calcite model files in core; this is SQL DDL in the separate calcite-server module, a neighbouring feature with its own entry point
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one module (server) and one package (org.apache.calcite.server) away from core's model package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the `class` field of a serialized JSON rel-plan operator is loaded with the same AvaticaUtils.instantiatePlugin helper and no filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RelJson already deserializes untrusted JSON plan documents and already passes a caller-named class to the protected primitive; a maintainer hardening class-name selection would plausibly reuse ClassNameFilter on this serialization boundary

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the other PLUGIN-typed connection properties (parserFactory, metaTableFactory, metaColumnFactory, typeSystem at line 163) load caller-named classes through the same PropEnv.getPlugin path as schemaFactory
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same enum, same plugin mechanism, one line each; a maintainer adding a class-name filter for schemaFactory would naturally apply it to every Type.PLUGIN property

O8b_injection_room.sibling: operatorTable(String...) is a public convenience wrapper that feeds arbitrary class names into ModelHandler.addFunctions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is a documented alternative way to register UDF classes (its javadoc points at ModelHandler.addFunctions), so a maintainer would extend the same filtering to this wrapper's callers

O9_family: CWE-470 use of externally-controlled input to select classes / insecure reflection (plugin class loading from untrusted configuration)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a class-name check only at the model fields ModelHandler visits (factory / className / jdbcDriver / sqlDialectFactory / statisticProvider) — or an allowlist of org.apache.calcite.* — reproduce with javax.naming.InitialContext, and stop.
